title: ProposalEnvelope
description: Output contract for the incident-synthesizer agent (A3). One envelope proposes one gate synthesized from one incident. Materialized to .pe/incident-proposals/<slug>/ for operator review. The engine NEVER auto-applies these — human writes the PR against the engine repo.

proposal_type.description: Distinguishes from other proposal envelopes (e.g. future doctrine-revision). Always 'gate-synthesis' for A3.

incident_summary.description: One-paragraph plain-English description of what went wrong. Cited, not paraphrased — the operator must be able to trace this back to the source.

ref.description: Path or identifier the operator can dereference (e.g. 'docs/dev-log/weekly/2026-W27.md' or '.pe/decisions.jsonl:sha-abc123').

failure_class.description: Free-form short slug for the failure pattern (e.g. 'sql-injection', 'unbounded-query', 'missing-tenant-filter', 'ai-aesthetic-drift', 'missing-transaction'). NOT constrained to the gate-envelope failure_class enum — that is per-invocation; this is per-pattern.

proposed_gate_kind.description: Which layer of the engine gets the new gate. sast_rule → templates/perf/*.yml or hooks/sast-scan.sh; hook → hooks/*.sh; test_fixture → evals/fixtures/<gate>/<slug>/; policy_toml → policy/*.toml; agent_revision → edit to an existing agents/*.md.

confidence.description: The synthesizer's own confidence that this proposal, if merged, would catch a recurrence. LOW confidence (<0.5) MUST still be emitted — the operator decides whether to escalate to a manual RFC.

path.description: Path RELATIVE TO ENGINE REPO ROOT. Never absolute. Never contains '..'.

content.description: For action=create: the full file contents. For action=modify: the FULL new contents of the file (operator diffs against current).

rationale.description: One-paragraph explanation of why this file is the right layer for this gate. Cited if referring to an existing pattern.

corpus_fixture.description: The A2 fixture that must be added alongside the gate so the shape runner proves the gate catches the incident class. Directory prefix (pass-/fail-escalate-/adversarial-) implied by the fixture's expected verdict.

gate.description: Which gate agent's corpus this fixture joins (e.g. 'security-reviewer').

slug.description: Directory slug WITHOUT the verdict prefix — the runner assembles it (e.g. 'sql-injection-string-format').

regression_check.description: One-sentence description of how the operator should verify, after merging the proposal, that a recurrence of the original incident would now be caught. Concrete: 'run pe gate parse against evals/fixtures/security-reviewer/fail-escalate-<slug>/expected-envelope.json — exit 1.'

notes.description: Optional freeform. Caveats, alternative approaches considered, or 'confidence LOW because...'.
